1. This order may be cited as the Statutory Bodies (Discipline and Surcharge)

(Amendment of First Schedule) Order 2020.

Amendment of First Schedule

2. The First Schedule to the Act is amended—

(a) in item 11, by inserting after the words "Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan

Awam Darat" the words "(dissolved via the Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan

Awam Darat (Dissolution) Act 2018 [Act 811])"; and

(b) by inserting after item 11 the following item:

"12. Public Sector Home Financing Board".

Made 8 January 2020

[JPA.BK(S)343/21; PN(PU2)613/II]

 Tun Dr. Mahathir bin Mohamad

Prime Minister

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Jitra–Sungai

Dua (Butterworth) Expressway) (Amendment) Order 2020

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Jitra–Sungai Dua (Butterworth) Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2020.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 February 2020.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Jitra-Sungai

Dua (Butterworth)) Expressway Order 1993 [P.U. (A) 229/1993], which is

referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in subparagraph

2(1) by substituting for the words "12 January 2012 to 31 December 2038"

the words "1 February 2020 to 31 December 2058".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:
